description: This Java source file defines an Android activity called MediaScannerActivity, which is responsible for triggering media scanning, inserting mock media items (songs, albums, artists) into the MediaStore database, and handling related UI updates and broadcast receiver events.

classes.name: MediaScannerActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity that tests media scanning and media content insertion by programmatically adding media data and triggering the media scanner.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI, broadcasts receiver, and prepares media insertion.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources such as broadcast receivers and scheduled messages.

methods.name: startScan
methods.description: Triggers the media scanner by sending a mounted intent to external storage.

methods.name: setInsertButtonText
methods.description: Updates the button label based on the number of items to insert.

methods.name: insertItems
methods.description: Starts or stops the media item insertion process via handler messaging.

methods.name: addAlbum
methods.description: Adds a mock album with ten songs to the MediaStore database.

methods.name: getRandomWord
methods.description: Generates a random 'word' by concatenating random syllables.

methods.name: getRandomName
methods.description: Generates a random artist name with optional modifiers.
